Molly A.: Quick follow-up from the RFC: propose replacing separate flags (use_fp8/use_int8/force_4bit) with a single precisionProfile envelope in the SDK. Want to capture compatibility concerns + rollout plan.
Kevin L.: Runtime backwards compatible? customers on older SDKs.
Molly A.: Yes. Runtime will accept legacy flags and convert server-side to canonical precisionProfile. Deprecate flags in SDK v2.0.
Julia P.: Impact on telemetry? dashboards/alerts rely on existing flag strings.
Raj S.: KV-cache blobs embed precision packing metadata. Changing schema could break hot cache across fleet. Need compat shim.
Kevin L.: Suggest explicit version header in serialized blobs (e.g., "pp-v1" vs "pp-v2") so older runtimes ignore new fields.
Molly A.: Plan: 1) server accepts both inputs; 2) runtime emits canonical profile + "source_hint" for back-compat; 3) serialization includes version tag. Rollout via feature-flag over 4 weeks.
Julia P.: I'll own dashboard migration: produce mapping table so alerts keep firing during rollout.
Raj S.: Quality gating: require per-profile fidelity checks. FP8/INT8 swaps subtle. Add synthetic prompt suite for shadowing.
Molly A.: Proposal: 48h shadowing per canary with computed degeneration score; if deg > threshold, auto-fallback to baseline profile.
Kevin L.: Add runtime response header "precision_notice" so client SDKs can warn about deprecated flags. Minimal surface.
Julia P.: Enterprise per-customer overrides? customers use policy-level precision keys.
Molly A.: We'll map legacy override keys to new profile names; ops will get a migration runbook.
Raj S.: Perf telemetry: maintain token-level timings across conversions. Avoid double-counting tokens converted server-side.
Molly A.: Noted.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: precision-profile-shim v1 -> staging at 2024-07-18T03:00Z.
ops-bot: Deployment started for precision-profile-shim v1 to staging (build 2024.07.18.1).
Kevin L.: Action: I'll add serialization version header and compatibility tests.
Julia P.: Action: I'll produce dashboard mapping and synthetic prompt suite.
Raj S.: Action: I'll draft canary gating thresholds + rollback playbook (include KV-cache eviction).
Molly A.: Action: I'll update SDK RFC, draft deprecation copy for customers, and schedule phasing. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
